title: HR ,replicate 1, scRNAseq
characteristics_ch1: group: HR(High immune response to hepatitis B vaccine group)
extract_protocol_ch1: Fresh whole blood was diluted with equal volume PBS (Tianjin Hao Yang Biological Manufacture Co., Ltd.) and then added to a centrifuge tube containing Human Lymphocyte Separation Medium (Dakewe Biotech Co., Ltd.) and centrifuged at 700×g for 20 min. Peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) was between the plasma layer and the separation fluid layer, then it was carefully drain into another centrifuge tube and washed twice with PBS (Phosphate buffered saline).  1mL medium that contained 10% Foetal Bovine Serum (FBS) and 90% Iscove’s Modified Dulbecco Medium (IMDM) were added to suspend the PBMC again. After the PBMC was prepared into single cell suspension, Luna-FL automatic cell counting apparatus was used to measure the cell count and cell survival rate. The cell activity was higher than 85% and the dead cells were removed with dead cell removal kit. Finally, the cell concentration was adjusted to the ideal concentration of 700-1200 cells /μL.

scRNA-seq libraries were constructed Using a Single Cell 3′v3.1 Library and Gel Bead kit (10X Genomics, 1000121) and Chromium Single Cell A Chip kit (10X Genomics, 1000120) according to the manufacturer’s introduction.
